q: Center manifold reduction at a non-hyperbolic equilibrium works because the center manifold W^c is attracting and carries the essential bifurcation dynamics. Specifically, after the reduction to ẋ_c = f_c(x_c) on W^c:
opts: Bifurcations in the full system correspond bijectively to bifurcations in the reduced system on W^c
The reduced system has more equilibria
exp: Center manifold theorem: the qualitative dynamics (number and stability of equilibria, limit cycles) near the bifurcation is captured by the reduced equation on W^c. The center manifold is computed as a formal power series in x_c.
